newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Weak demand weighs on market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Weak demand weighs on market.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were steady to weaker on Wednesday with sluggish demand weighing on values in some areas, dealers said.

"I'm hearing flour mills' run times are better than some people expected and demand is just not there," one dealer said, noting prices in Kansas City were down about $3.00 with bids at $92.00 at offers at $94.00.

Some dealers expressed surprise that demand was so slow, given winter weather continued to keep most cattle off pasture and on feed but others said there seemed to be a slump in demand each February although the reason for it was not clear.
